issues.description: The UML in the problem statement defines the lecture attributes as private ( '-' ), but the template Lecture.java declares two attributes (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents) as public. The solution implementation uses private attributes. This visibility mismatch may confuse students about the intended access level (whether to add attributes as public or private) and whether they should modify the existing public fields or add new private ones.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the UML and the solution by changing the visibility of the pre-declared attributes in the template to private (or remove them and let students add private attributes). Alternatively, update the UML/instructions to explicitly indicate that attributes may be public if that is intended. Prefer making template fields private to match the UML and the solution implementation.
